about: COPY of oceanmetrics/erddap-places catalog/tests/union_bbox_cases.json (keep the two in step): unionBbox() (erddap-places app/src/lib/gazetteer.ts), union_bbox() (erddap-places catalog/erin_layers/bbox.py) and union_bbox() (gazetteer/bbox.py here) must all give `want` for `boxes`; [west, south, east, north], west > east crosses the antimeridian

cases.name: PMNM lobes, one each side of 180: crosses instead of spanning the globe
plain boxes far apart: the widest gap is round the back of the globe, so no crossing
boxes either side of 180 that do not touch it still cross (the gap across 180 is the narrow one)
a crossing box unioned with a plain one (a collection holding PMNM and the mainland)
boxes that cover every longitude give -180..180
a tie between the gap across 180 and an inner gap keeps the box that does not cross
portolan's two halves of a crossing extent join back into one crossing box
